_comment: Performance regression gate baseline (alpha-plan item F2). The CI 'perf-gate' job runs scripts/perf-gate.sh, which times `tyc build <corpus> --no-sync --check` (the full preprocess->parse->check->comptime->desugar->emit->format pipeline) over N runs and FAILS if the median exceeds median_ms by more than `threshold`. See docs/performance-baseline.md for full methodology.
metric: tyc build pipeline wall-clock, median of runs, milliseconds
threshold_meaning: fail when measured median > median_ms * (1 + threshold)
refresh: Run 'scripts/perf-gate.sh --update' on a quiet machine and commit this file. Do this only for an intentional, justified change (new pass, larger corpus). The CI runner is noisier than a laptop, so this number is a conservative upper bound; expect local runs to be faster.
